title: What It Actually Looks Like for a Godly Man to Serve at Church and at Home
caption:
What it actually looks like for a godly man to serve at church and at home.

He'll carry tables at the church cookout the second someone asks. At home, the trash sits for three days until his roommate says something. That's not two different guys. That's one guy, and the version behind closed doors is the real one.

Serve where nobody's clapping. Ask the people who actually live with you if the guy they know matches the guy everyone else calls solid. The dishes you do without being asked say more about the man you're becoming than anything you do in front of a crowd.
